findings.rule: Server-local port placement (vendor/shared is for cross-package ports only)
findings.explanation: ArchiveStore is a server-only port: no package outside server/ names it (nothing in client/ or reviewer-core/ references the exports feature). vendor/shared is hand-synced and mirrored into client/, so parking a server-only port there widens the shared surface for nothing; the skill's rule is that such a port is declared beside its adapter, per the Tokenizer precedent.
findings.fix: Move the ArchiveStore interface out of vendor/shared/adapters.ts into server/src/adapters/archive/index.ts, exported alongside FsArchiveStore, and import it from there in the container.

findings.rule: Compose only at the root / external I/O via container-provided ports (rules 3 & 6)
findings.explanation: The application-layer ExportsService imports the concrete FsArchiveStore adapter and constructs it inline, reading process.env config and the EXPORT_SIGNING_SECRET directly. This wires infrastructure into the application ring, bypasses the composition root (the Container has no archive slot and no ContainerOverrides.archive), leaks secret/config handling out of the root, and makes the filesystem I/O unswappable in tests.
findings.fix: Wire FsArchiveStore in platform/container.ts behind the ArchiveStore port (sourcing rootDir/signing secret from AppConfig/SecretsProvider), add an archive field to ContainerOverrides, and inject the ArchiveStore into ExportsService via its constructor; the service then codes only against the port.
